source.name: Ministarstvo pravde Republike Srbije – Registar posrednika (xlsx, stanje 24.09.2026)

note: 3,457 records in the register export; 1057 with STATUS=true (taken as currently licensed), one row per person. Inactive/expired (STATUS=false, 2,400) excluded. The export does not mark its street address as an office address, so address is left null (town from register GRAD only); phones and e-mail are the contact data the register publishes. JMBG, birth data and parent name in the file were not used. Caveat: the register's revocation/expiry columns are inconsistently filled, so STATUS is the only activity signal used.
